heading: Tonight
text: Mostly clear. Lows from the mid-20s to near 30, mid-30s along Lake Champlain. Calm wind.

heading: Sunday
text: Mostly sunny. Highs from the upper 50s to near 60 north, in the low to mid 60s south. Calm wind.

heading: Sunday Night
text: Mostly clear south, a few passing clouds north. Lows in the 30s, nearing 40 in the Saint Lawrence Valley. Light and variable wind.
